rules.content:
title: TAE Infrastructure Rotation Detection
status: experimental
description: Detect Threat Actor Ecosystem (TAE) infrastructure rotation patterns used by bulletproof hosting providers to evade sanctions and takedowns: (1) IP prefix transfers between related Autonomous Systems 
logsource:
    product: network
    category: routing_analytics
    service: bgp_monitoring
detection:
    selection_prefix_transfer:
        prefix_transfer_days|lt: 30
        source_asn_related: true
        destination_asn_related: true
    selection_new_org:
        new_organization_age_days|lt: 90
        ripe_resource_allocation: true
        organization_verification_status: "minimal"
    selection_threat_density:
        threat_density_score|gt: 0.6
        prefix_announcement_age_days|lt: 14
        historical_abuse_on_prefix: false
    selection_rebranding:
        asn_name_change_days|lt: 60
        infrastructure_overlap_score|gt: 0.7
    condition: (selection_prefix_transfer and selection_new_org) or selection_threat_density or (selection_prefix_transfer and selection_rebranding)
level: high
rules.title: DL-0123: TAE Infrastructure Rotation Detection (Sigma)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for BPH ASN Connection Correlation")`
`comment("Detects traffic to known BPH ASNs, NiceNIC domains, or Dynamic DNS abuse")`
index=flame_network sourcetype=flame:dns_monitoring
| lookup bph_asn_watchlist destination_asn OUTPUT bph_provider_name, bph_risk_level
| eval bph_asn_match = if(isnotnull(bph_provider_name), 1, 0)
| eval nicenic_match = if(like(domain_registrar, "%nicenic%"), 1, 0)
| eval dyndns_match = if(
    match(query, "\.(afraid\.org|mooo\.com|hopto\.org|zapto\.org|sytes\.net)$"), 1, 0)
| where bph_asn_match=1 OR nicenic_match=1 OR dyndns_match=1
| eval match_type = case(
    bph_asn_match=1, "bph_asn",
    nicenic_match=1, "nicenic_registrar",
    dyndns_match=1, "dynamic_dns")
| eval risk_category = case(
    bph_asn_match=1 AND nicenic_match=1, "high",
    bph_asn_match=1, "medium",
    nicenic_match=1, "medium",
    dyndns_match=1, "low")
| stats count AS connection_count dc(src_ip) AS unique_sources
        values(query) AS domains values(destination_asn) AS asns
        values(bph_provider_name) AS bph_providers
        values(match_type) AS match_types
  by src_ip
| sort - connection_count
rules.title: DL-0178: Bulletproof Hosting ASN Connection Correlation — Traffic to Known BPH Networks (SPLUNK)
